page.overview:
What is Adventure Endo-02?

Adventure Endo-02 belongs to Five Nights at Freddy's. is an endoskeleton and one of the unlockable characters in FNaF World.

Endo-02's has almost an identical appearance to its counterpart from Five Nights at Freddy's 2 but smaller and "cuter." The wires from its core series character are missing, and the endoskeleton frame is much simpler. Endo-02 is a really good character by itself. It has Speed Song which can increase the speed for all characters for 1 minute (useless if using a Speed Chip).
